slug: 2025-11-03 Senegal taps inspiration from Togo's digital ID experience

facts.fact: Biometric Update says the New Deal Technologique is a digital transformation strategy 'launched by its president early in 2025'.
The article says the strategy is supported by the Gates Foundation with US$10 million; it states no domestic allocation.

note: Calls the New Deal Technologique a digital transformation strategy without describing its scope, so class is left empty. Launch by the president is recorded as adopted under the study's ladder. As_of for the Gates support is the publication date, the grant date not being given.
